svg.title: fig add type value
svg.desc:
The same signature appears above split boxes. Upper halves show types, red for the function and blue for Int. Lower halves distinguish add, 20, 22, and result 42 by color, with labels beneath. Arrows in the lower row are schematic application guides, not conversions between integers.
Source (split): sig: [add] : [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int] row: fn/add int/20 int/22 int/42 arrows: 3->4
